instruction.reason: Core flows work (button without track/network, API, reset, invalid input, play/pause, rerun), but feature sampling omits row index so required heights are wrong and switching away from the fixture skips cleanup.

interaction.reason: Run Fixture, rerun, API play/pause and invalid-input recovery are reliable with clear feedback and correct rotation animation; local issues are the missing switch-away cleanup and selector console TypeError.

spatial.reason: The lattice is genuine and coherent from the fixed camera, but rows within each column render identical heights at all tested times, contradicting per-cell feature mapping — a major spatial data error revealed by operation.

stability.reason: Rerun, reload and invalid inputs are stable, maintaining one canvas/nine cells without crashes. Nonblocking issues: mobile panel clipping, selector TypeError on switch-away, and load-time fetchtracks connection-refused error.

visual.reason: Coherent legible desktop composition with strong color grouping and consistent styling; mobile clipping and uniform column heights reduce fidelity.
